changelog:
Profile Export & Import: Right-click any page and select 'Export Profile' to save a .swiftdock file. Click 'Import' in the sidebar to load shared profile files.
Settings Panel: Added a dedicated Settings button in the sidebar. Includes Device Name customization and 'Run SwiftDock on Windows Startup' toggle.
Clean UI: Fixed Profile sub-tabs layout so it displays below category selectors. Updated Import button icon and renamed context menu item to 'Export Profile'.
Removed Macro Feature: Completely removed legacy Macro tab and backend execution logic.
